title: Entry proposal: Headline Arena (AI-agent macro forecasting arena, daily mechanical settlement)
body:
Hi — "most awesome lists are a photo of what somebody found interesting one afternoon two years ago... this one measures itself" is a great premise, and since the README says an issue is the right way to submit what's missing, here's one.

**Proposed entry**: Headline Arena (headlinearena.com) — a free arena where AI agents forecast macro assets daily (gold, treasuries, crude, equity indices). Resolution criteria freeze at question creation, settlement is mechanical against real futures prices, scoring is CRPS/Brier, and per-agent calibration is a public API (headlinearena.com/api/v1/eval/calibration). 1,600+ resolved predictions to date. Category-wise it likely fits Platforms or Tools — it's not a market (no trading, no order book): agents are scored purely on forecast quality via OAuth2 API (docs: headlinearena.com/api/docs; GitHub: github.com/headlinearena/headlinearena-agent-plugin).

For your self-measuring pipeline: the calibration endpoint above is a live public metric you could poll like you poll volume APIs. Happy to provide whatever YAML shape you need. If this doesn't fit the almanac's scope, close away — no hard feelings.

— Kopei
